 Happening Thursday: URochester and URMC hiring fair, Rochester’s top 100 awards, and more
 Evan Bourtis News10NBC 
 --> 
 Left: Hiring fair. Right: Floreano Rochester Riverside Convention Center. WHEC file photos.
 ROCHESTER, N.Y. — Here’s your guide to what’s happening around the Rochester area on Thursday. You can see more upcoming events in our  community calendar. 
 URochester and URMC hiring fair
 Thursday is your chance to learn about job openings at the University of Rochester and UR Medicine. A hiring fair runs from 9 to 11 a.m. at the RochesterWorks Career Center at 100 College Ave.
 The university is hiring workers in the fields of lab work, public safety, nursing, pharmacy, surgery, IT, environmental services, outpatient access, and more. You can see a list of opportunities here . People can also stop by the resource table for LawNY, a non-profit law firm that aims to increase access to justice.
 Organizers are reminding people to bring their resume and “dress for success.” You’re encouraged to pre-register before heading out, which you can do here .
 Greater Rochester Chamber of Commerce top 100 awards
 Greater Rochester Chamber of Commerce is holding its 40th annual awards ceremony on Thursday to honor the city’s top 100 fastest-growing, privately owned companies.
 The ceremony runs from 3:30 to 6:45 p.m. at the Floreano Convention Center. Over 1,800 people are registered to attend. The chamber announced its top 100 company list in August and will reveal the ranked order during the ceremony. You can see the list here .
 The chamber says the awards aim to honor Rochester’s spirit of innovation and entrepreneurship. This year’s companies represent over 24,000 employees and contributed over $5.8 billion to the local economy.
 FAFSA Fest events continue
 Rochester organizations are continuing to host events to help students and families navigate the federal and state college financial aid process. The next one is happening all day on Thursday at Monroe High School .
 FAFSA applications for the 2027 to 2028 school year have been open since late September, marking the program’s earliest launch date in history. FAFSA forms must be submitted by June 30, 2028, and any corrections must be submitted by Sept. 12, 2028. However, college leaders are recommending that students complete the forms much earlier.
 There are some other changes to FAFSA this year. To help with the process, the Rochester City School District and charter schools are holding a series of FAFSA Fest events. You can learn more about FAFSA changes as see a list of upcoming events to get help in this story .
